From: Karina Garcia <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, February 20, 2023 8:00 AM
To: Deborah Galindo < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Íñigo Fernández < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Elections coordination/ Met - USAID Guatemala
This Message Is From an External Sender
Inigo and Deborah,
Greetings from Guatemala. Cara and other colleagues from USAID / Washington have told us about opportunities
to work with Meta. I'm managing our elections project, implemented by CEPPS.I would like to meet with you to
discuss any coordination opportunity. Please let me know if you are available in the next few days and what would
be your time preferences to have a conversation, virtually or in person if you are in Guatemala.
Karina J. Garcia Ruano, Ph.D.
Project Management Specialist
Democracy and Governance Office
USAID/Guatemala
